# Tuned Performance

> Mobile car care, repairs, diagnostics, BMW/MINI coding, trim fitment, MOT support and ECU remap enquiries for Feltham and nearby areas.

Tuned Performance is a UK mobile car care business focused on practical vehicle support for local drivers. The website is designed to help customers choose the right route quickly: call, WhatsApp, email enquiry, pricing guide or estimator.

## Services

- Bumper repairs and single panel repair/re-spray.
- OBD diagnostics and warning light checks.
- BMW and MINI coding using BimmerCode for supported ECU hardware, hidden factory options and comfort feature personalisation.
- Trim, carbon mirror cap, diffuser, exhaust tip, air filter and intake fitment enquiries.
- MOT support and local route guidance.
- ECU remap enquiries and Stage 1 interest registration.
